name: GA Customs
description: Free iPhone and iPad app for general aviation pilots planning a U.S. customs arrival: a map of U.S. airports of entry with hours, user fee status and advance notice rules from CBP, a South Arrival filter for the designated airports in 19 CFR 122.24, offline airport information, tap to call the port and pilot reviews. GA Customs does not file eAPIS (pilots file through CBP's official eAPIS site, https://eapis.cbp.dhs.gov) and does not grant permission to land. Always verify with CBP before you fly.
operatingSystem: iOS 13.0 or later, iPadOS 13.0 or later
featureList: Map of U.S. airports of entry with hours and user fee status
Filters for 24-hour airports, user fee airports and notice requirements
South Arrival filter showing only designated airports (19 CFR 122.24), off by default
Airport pages with hours, fees and advance notice rules from CBP
Tap to call the CBP port from the airport page
Pilot reviews of how the clearance went
Offline access to saved airport information and CBP fact sheets where published
